purpose: Human review of all published phrase content
reviewGuide: Japanese is natural, polite, concise, and suitable for the situation.
Romaji matches the Japanese reading and follows a consistent style.
English accurately expresses the intent of the Japanese.
Show-to-staff wording is safe and clear when shown without extra context.
Food allergy and dietary restriction wording does not create a false guarantee of safety.
Replace 〇〇 / [allergen] with the traveler’s specific allergen before presenting an allergy phrase to staff.

problems.title: I can’t exit the ticket gate
problems.shortDescription: The ticket gate won’t let me through.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when your ticket or IC card does not let you leave the station.

phrases.japanese: すみません、改札から出られません。
phrases.english: Excuse me, I can’t get out through the ticket gate.

phrases.japanese: この切符で大丈夫ですか？
phrases.romaji: Kono kippu de daijōbu desu ka?
phrases.english: Is this ticket okay?

phrases.japanese: どうすればいいですか？
phrases.english: What should I do?

staffMessage.japanese: すみません、改札から出られません。
staffMessage.english: Excuse me, I can’t get out through the ticket gate.

problems.title: I got on the wrong train
problems.shortDescription: Help me find the right route.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you are on the wrong train or need a new route to your destination.

phrases.japanese: すみません、電車を間違えました。
phrases.english: Excuse me, I got on the wrong train.

phrases.japanese: この駅に行きたいです。
phrases.english: I want to go to this station.

phrases.japanese: どこで乗り換えればいいですか？
phrases.romaji: Doko de norikaereba ii desu ka?
phrases.english: Where should I change trains?

staffMessage.japanese: すみません、電車を間違えました。
staffMessage.english: Excuse me, I got on the wrong train.

problems.title: I can’t find the right platform
problems.shortDescription: Which platform should I use?
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you know your destination but do not know where to board.

phrases.japanese: ここへ行きたいのですが、何番線ですか？
phrases.romaji: Koko e ikitai no desu ga, nanbansen desu ka?
phrases.english: Which platform is the train to this station?

phrases.japanese: このホームで合っていますか？
phrases.romaji: Kono hōmu de atte imasu ka?
phrases.english: Am I on the right platform?

phrases.japanese: 次の電車でいいですか？
phrases.romaji: Tsugi no densha de ii desu ka?
phrases.english: Should I take the next train?

staffMessage.japanese: ここへ行きたいのですが、何番線ですか？
staffMessage.english: Which platform is the train to this station?

problems.title: My IC card balance is too low
problems.shortDescription: I need to add money or pay the fare.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when your IC card does not have enough balance for the fare.

phrases.japanese: ICカードの残高が足りません。
phrases.romaji: IC kādo no zandaka ga tarimasen.
phrases.english: My IC card balance is not enough.

phrases.japanese: どこでチャージできますか？
phrases.english: Where can I add money to it?

phrases.japanese: 不足分を現金で払えますか？
phrases.romaji: Fusokubun o genkin de haraemasu ka?
phrases.english: Can I pay the difference in cash?

staffMessage.japanese: ICカードの残高が足りません。
staffMessage.english: My IC card balance is not enough.

problems.title: I left something on the train
problems.shortDescription: Help me report a lost item.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you need to report something left behind on a train.

phrases.japanese: 電車に忘れ物をしました。
phrases.english: I left something on the train.

phrases.japanese: この電車に乗っていました。
phrases.english: I was on this train.

phrases.japanese: どこに問い合わせればいいですか？
phrases.romaji: Doko ni toiawasereba ii desu ka?
phrases.english: Who should I contact?

staffMessage.japanese: 電車に忘れ物をしました。
staffMessage.english: I left something on the train.

problems.title: I can’t find the check-in counter
problems.shortDescription: Where should I check in for my flight?
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you need to find the correct airline check-in counter.

phrases.japanese: チェックインカウンターはどこですか？
phrases.romaji: Chekkuin kauntā wa doko desu ka?
phrases.english: Where is the check-in counter?

phrases.japanese: この航空会社のカウンターを探しています。
phrases.romaji: Kono kōkū gaisha no kauntā o sagashite imasu.
phrases.english: I’m looking for this airline’s counter.

phrases.japanese: この便はここでチェックインできますか？
phrases.romaji: Kono bin wa koko de chekkuin dekimasu ka?
phrases.english: Can I check in for this flight here?

staffMessage.japanese: チェックインカウンターを探しています。
staffMessage.english: I’m looking for the check-in counter.

problems.title: My flight is delayed or canceled
problems.shortDescription: I need to know what to do next.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when your flight status has changed and you need instructions.

phrases.japanese: この便は遅れていますか？
phrases.romaji: Kono bin wa okurete imasu ka?
phrases.english: Is this flight delayed?

phrases.japanese: この便は欠航ですか？
phrases.romaji: Kono bin wa kekkō desu ka?
phrases.english: Is this flight canceled?

phrases.japanese: 次にどうすればいいですか？
phrases.romaji: Tsugi ni dō sureba ii desu ka?
phrases.english: What should I do next?

staffMessage.japanese: この便の状況を教えてください。
staffMessage.english: Please tell me the status of this flight.

problems.title: My baggage is missing
problems.shortDescription: My bag did not arrive at baggage claim.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when your checked baggage has not arrived.

phrases.japanese: 預けた荷物が出てきません。
phrases.english: My checked baggage has not arrived.

phrases.japanese: この便に乗っていました。
phrases.english: I was on this flight.

phrases.japanese: どこで手続きすればいいですか？
phrases.romaji: Doko de tetsuzuki sureba ii desu ka?
phrases.english: Where should I report it?

staffMessage.japanese: 預けた荷物が見つかりません。
staffMessage.english: I can’t find my checked baggage.

problems.title: I have a problem at security
problems.shortDescription: I need help understanding the security check.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you need help during the security check.

phrases.japanese: 保安検査で止められました。
phrases.english: I was stopped at the security check.

phrases.japanese: これは機内に持ち込めますか？
phrases.romaji: Kore wa kinai ni mochikomemasu ka?
phrases.english: Can I take this onto the plane?

phrases.japanese: どうすればいいか教えてください。
phrases.romaji: Dō sureba ii ka oshiete kudasai.
phrases.english: Please tell me what I should do.

staffMessage.japanese: 保安検査について教えてください。
staffMessage.english: Please explain the security check to me.

problems.title: I can’t find my boarding gate
problems.shortDescription: Where should I go to board my flight?
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you need to locate the correct boarding gate.

phrases.japanese: この便の搭乗口はどこですか？
phrases.romaji: Kono bin no tōjōguchi wa doko desu ka?
phrases.english: Where is the boarding gate for this flight?

phrases.japanese: この搭乗口で合っていますか？
phrases.romaji: Kono tōjōguchi de atte imasu ka?
phrases.english: Is this the correct boarding gate?

phrases.japanese: 搭乗はもう始まっていますか？
phrases.romaji: Tōjō wa mō hajimatte imasu ka?
phrases.english: Has boarding started already?

staffMessage.japanese: この便の搭乗口を探しています。
staffMessage.english: I’m looking for the boarding gate for this flight.

problems.title: I need help ordering
problems.shortDescription: I want to understand the menu and order.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you need help reading the menu or placing an order.

phrases.japanese: メニューを教えてもらえますか？
phrases.english: Could you explain the menu to me?

phrases.japanese: おすすめはどれですか？
phrases.english: Which one do you recommend?

phrases.japanese: これを一つお願いします。
phrases.english: One of these, please.

staffMessage.japanese: 注文を手伝っていただけますか？
staffMessage.english: Could you help me order?

problems.title: I have a food allergy
problems.shortDescription: I need to check what is in the food.
problems.situation: Use these phrases to tell staff about an allergy and ask about ingredients.

phrases.japanese: 〇〇アレルギーがあります。
phrases.english: I am allergic to [allergen].

phrases.japanese: これに〇〇は入っていますか？
phrases.romaji: Kore ni 〇〇 wa haitte imasu ka?
phrases.english: Does this contain [allergen]?

phrases.japanese: 少量の〇〇でも症状が出ます。材料を確認していただけますか？
phrases.romaji: Shōryō no 〇〇 demo shōjō ga demasu. Zairyō o kakunin shite itadakemasu ka?
phrases.english: Even a small amount of [allergen] can cause a reaction. Could you check the ingredients?

staffMessage.japanese: 〇〇アレルギーがあります。少量でも危険です。材料を確認していただけますか？
staffMessage.english: I am allergic to [allergen]. Even a small amount is dangerous. Could you check the ingredients?

problems.title: My order is wrong
problems.shortDescription: This is not what I ordered.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when the food or drink served is different from your order.

phrases.japanese: すみません、注文したものと違います。
phrases.romaji: Sumimasen, chūmon shita mono to chigaimasu.
phrases.english: Excuse me, this is different from what I ordered.

phrases.japanese: これを注文しました。
phrases.english: I ordered this.

phrases.japanese: 確認してもらえますか？
phrases.english: Could you check, please?

staffMessage.japanese: 注文したものと違います。確認してください。
staffMessage.english: This is not what I ordered. Please check.

problems.title: I need a vegetarian option
problems.shortDescription: I want a meal without meat or fish.
problems.situation: Use these phrases to ask for a meal without meat, fish, or fish-based stock.

phrases.japanese: 私はベジタリアンです。
phrases.english: I am vegetarian.

phrases.japanese: 肉と魚を使っていない料理はありますか？
phrases.romaji: Niku to sakana o tsukatte inai ryōri wa arimasu ka?
phrases.english: Do you have a dish without meat or fish?

phrases.japanese: この料理に魚のだしは入っていますか？
phrases.romaji: Kono ryōri ni sakana no dashi wa haitte imasu ka?
phrases.english: Does this dish contain fish stock?

staffMessage.japanese: 肉、魚、魚のだし、肉エキスを使っていない料理をお願いします。
staffMessage.english: Please give me a dish without meat, fish, fish stock, or meat extract.

problems.title: I want to pay the bill
problems.shortDescription: I need the check and payment options.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you are ready to pay or need to ask about payment.

phrases.japanese: お会計をお願いします。
phrases.english: The bill, please.

phrases.japanese: カードで払えますか？
phrases.english: Can I pay by card?

phrases.japanese: 別々に払えますか？
phrases.english: Can we pay separately?

staffMessage.japanese: お会計をお願いします。
staffMessage.english: The bill, please.

problems.title: I can’t check in
problems.shortDescription: There is a problem with my reservation.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when staff cannot find your reservation or check-in cannot be completed.

phrases.japanese: チェックインをお願いします。
phrases.english: I’d like to check in, please.

phrases.japanese: 予約が見つからないようです。
phrases.english: It seems my reservation cannot be found.

phrases.japanese: 予約確認書を見てもらえますか？
phrases.romaji: Yoyaku kakuninsho o mite moraemasu ka?
phrases.english: Could you look at my booking confirmation?

staffMessage.japanese: 予約がありますが、チェックインできません。
staffMessage.english: I have a reservation, but I can’t check in.

problems.title: There’s a problem with my room
problems.shortDescription: Something in the room is not working.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when something in your hotel room needs attention.

phrases.japanese: 部屋に問題があります。
phrases.english: There is a problem with my room.

phrases.japanese: エアコンが動きません。
phrases.english: The air conditioner is not working.

phrases.japanese: 部屋を確認してもらえますか？
phrases.romaji: Heya o kakunin shite moraemasu ka?
phrases.english: Could you check the room?

staffMessage.japanese: 部屋に問題があります。確認してください。
staffMessage.english: There is a problem with my room. Please check it.

problems.title: I need to store my luggage
problems.shortDescription: Can the hotel keep my bags for a while?
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you want the hotel to hold your luggage.

phrases.japanese: 荷物を預かってもらえますか？
phrases.english: Could you store my luggage?

phrases.japanese: チェックインまで預けたいです。
phrases.english: I’d like to leave it here until check-in.

phrases.japanese: 今日の夕方に取りに来ます。
phrases.romaji: Kyō no yūgata ni tori ni kimasu.
phrases.english: I’ll pick it up this evening.

staffMessage.japanese: 荷物を預かっていただけますか？
staffMessage.english: Could you store my luggage?

problems.title: I’m locked out of my room
problems.shortDescription: My room key is not working.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when your room key does not open the door.

phrases.japanese: 部屋の鍵が使えません。
phrases.english: My room key is not working.

phrases.japanese: 部屋に入れません。
phrases.english: I can’t get into my room.

phrases.japanese: 新しい鍵をもらえますか？
phrases.english: Could I get a new key?

staffMessage.japanese: 部屋の鍵が使えず、部屋に入れません。
staffMessage.english: My room key does not work, and I can’t enter my room.

problems.title: I need help with checkout
problems.shortDescription: I have a question about leaving or paying.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when checking out or asking about the final bill.

phrases.japanese: チェックアウトをお願いします。
phrases.english: I’d like to check out, please.

phrases.japanese: 追加料金について教えてください。
phrases.romaji: Tsuika ryōkin ni tsuite oshiete kudasai.
phrases.english: Please tell me about the additional charges.

phrases.japanese: 支払いはこれで終わりですか？
phrases.romaji: Shiharai wa kore de owari desu ka?
phrases.english: Is my payment complete?

staffMessage.japanese: チェックアウトをお願いします。
staffMessage.english: I’d like to check out, please.

problems.title: I can’t find an item
problems.shortDescription: I need help finding a product in the store.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you need staff to help you locate a product.

phrases.japanese: この商品を探しています。

phrases.japanese: これはどこにありますか？
phrases.romaji: Kore wa doko ni arimasu ka?
phrases.english: Where can I find this?

phrases.japanese: 在庫はありますか？

staffMessage.japanese: この商品を探しています。
staffMessage.english: I’m looking for this item.

problems.title: I need a different size or color
problems.shortDescription: Do you have another option available?
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you need another size or color of an item.

phrases.japanese: 別のサイズはありますか？
phrases.romaji: Betsu no saizu wa arimasu ka?
phrases.english: Do you have another size?

phrases.japanese: もっと大きいサイズはありますか？
phrases.romaji: Motto ōkii saizu wa arimasu ka?
phrases.english: Do you have a larger size?

phrases.japanese: 別の色はありますか？
phrases.romaji: Betsu no iro wa arimasu ka?
phrases.english: Do you have another color?

staffMessage.japanese: この商品の別のサイズか色を探しています。
staffMessage.english: I’m looking for another size or color of this item.

problems.title: I want to know the price
problems.shortDescription: I can’t find or understand the price.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you need to confirm an item’s price or discount.

phrases.japanese: これはいくらですか？
phrases.english: How much is this?

phrases.japanese: 表示価格は税込みですか？
phrases.romaji: Hyōji kakaku wa zeikomi desu ka?
phrases.english: Does the displayed price include tax?

phrases.japanese: これはセール品ですか？
phrases.english: Is this item on sale?

staffMessage.japanese: この商品の値段を教えてください。
staffMessage.english: Please tell me the price of this item.

problems.title: I want to make a tax-free purchase
problems.shortDescription: I need help with the tax-free process.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you want to ask about tax-free shopping.

phrases.japanese: 免税で買えますか？
phrases.english: Can I buy this tax-free?

phrases.japanese: 免税手続きはどこでできますか？
phrases.romaji: Menzei tetsuzuki wa doko de dekimasu ka?
phrases.english: Where can I complete the tax-free procedure?

phrases.japanese: パスポートが必要ですか？
phrases.english: Do I need my passport?

staffMessage.japanese: 免税手続きをしたいです。
staffMessage.english: I would like to complete the tax-free procedure.

problems.title: I need to return or exchange something
problems.shortDescription: There is a problem with something I bought.
problems.situation: Use these phrases when you want to ask about returning or exchanging an item.

phrases.japanese: これを返品したいです。
phrases.english: I would like to return this.

phrases.japanese: 別の商品と交換できますか？
phrases.romaji: Betsu no shōhin to kōkan dekimasu ka?
phrases.english: Can I exchange it for another item?

phrases.japanese: レシートはこちらです。
